rules: No generic fonts (Inter, Roboto, Open Sans) for headings.
Line height: leading-none for headers, leading-relaxed for body.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Hard, offset shadows ONLY (e.g., shadow-[4px_4px_0px_#0A0A0A]). No soft diffuse shadows.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #E4E4E7 or #0A0A0A everywhere. Use border-collapse for bento grids.
visual_enhancers.border_radius: rounded-none everywhere to reinforce the rigid, authoritative marketplace feel.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used ONLY for sticky headers: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 with border-b border-black/10. Do NOT use transparent backgrounds.

grids_and_layouts.general_spacing: Generous. Use p-8 to p-16 for containers. Grid gaps should be gap-8.
grids_and_layouts.dashboard_mode: High Density Grid (Mode B). Strict grid hierarchy, col-span-1 to col-span-3, no jagged bottoms. All dashboard widgets must align flawlessly.
grids_and_layouts.browse_talent_mode: The 'Tetris' Grid (Mode A). Asymmetric list. Don't use standard equal-square grids. Stagger talent cards.
grids_and_layouts.contract_modal: Must look like physical paper. Use max-w-3xl, centered, p-12, bg-[#FDFCF0], bordered.

components.buttons: Square edges (rounded-none). Primary: bg-[#002FA7] text-white hover:bg-[#0A0A0A]. Accent: bg-[#FF0A0A] text-white.
components.inputs: Shadcn inputs customized to rounded-none, border-black/20, focus:border-[#002FA7] focus:ring-0.
components.cards: Flat background, 1px border border-[#0A0A0A], no shadow. Hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1) and shadow-[6px_6px_0px_0px_rgba(10,10,10,1)].
components.charts: Shadcn (Recharts). Use purely solid colors (no gradients in charts). Use Donut charts for Hours Purchased vs. Allocated.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Crisp, immediate transitions. transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1).
motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Fade and slight slide-up on entry.
motion_and_interactions.marquee: Use react-fast-marquee for '12-MONTH EXCLUSIVITY GUARANTEED - PREMIUM TALENT ONLY' in a ticker across the page.

accessibility.contrast: APCA standards preferred. Normal text min 4.5:1. Primary blue (#002FA7) against white passes easily.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.

media.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone or Regular weight). Installation: yarn add @phosphor-icons/react

image_urls.description: Black and white abstract geometric dome architecture for a structural, authoritative hero section.
Creative professional portrait for talent cards.
Four professionals in a business meeting, used for the employer landing/how-it-works section.

media.image_constraints: Max-height 80vh on mobile. Max overlay opacity: bg-black/40 for hero text contrast.

3d_libraries.strategy: No Heavy 3D required for the core dashboard, but Recharts (Shadcn) must be utilized for hours and budget tracking.

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow 'The Anti-AI Designer' E1 principles: No generic Bootstrap columns, no soft dropshadows.
Implement the strict 12-month exclusivity warning explicitly on the contract modal and dashboard.
Ensure 'Mix-and-match booking flow' UI is built as an interactive allocation slider or grid where employers distribute hours among shortlisted talent.
Do NOT use HTML `<select>` or `<input type="date">`. Rely completely on customized Shadcn primitives.
For the contract signature modal, use a handwritten script font 'Caveat' for the visual signature, with a clear 'Agree & Sign' CTA.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, but keep borders sharp for this Swiss Brutalist theme.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all).
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is banned).
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡) for icons.
Missing images must not default to placeholder text. Use the exact provided image URLs.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
